title: Every 3MF made for your slicer and printer, and space to spare
summary: With 1.7.0, a model opens in your slicer as if it had been made there, for the printer you print on. Open adapted now works for a 3MF from any site, in every slicer Thingport opens: a Bambu Studio project, a PrusaSlicer one or a plain 3MF in colours keeps its parts, plates, painting and the designer's settings. Add your printers under Configuration → Printer, or find them in your printer makers' accounts, and the copy names your slicer's own presets for your printer, with its plates moved onto your bed. Thingport Grab makes the same copies on nine sites with Download adapted, with or without a Thingport instance. Administration → Storage shows what takes the disk and frees what isn't needed, from old 3D previews to extra photos, and new 3D previews take a fifth of the space. QIDI Maker and VoxelShare bring the sites Thingport imports from to twenty-three, with QIDI Studio and Flash Studio, and Snapmaker Space's and VoxelShare's China sites import too. Migrate brings people and libraries in from another instance, achievements put badges on My models, and Thingport and Grab speak Simplified Chinese.

items.title: Open adapted: any 3MF, from any site, in your slicer
items.description: A 3MF is usually its slicer's own project: a MakerWorld model is a Bambu Studio project, a Printables one often a PrusaSlicer one, and another slicer opens it without its colours, parts, plates or settings. Open normalized, offered on MakerWorld models only, becomes Open adapted in your slicer: a copy of the file made for the slicer you open it in, so it opens there as close as it can to a file made there. Thingport reads what kind of 3MF each file is, whichever site it came from. PrusaSlicer and eufyMake Studio get a copy that joins your own printer, filament and settings, with the designer's layer height, walls, infill and supports on each object, and its parts, modifiers and painting kept. Cura gets a Cura project (5.7 and later), each object on its extruder. Bambu Studio and the slicers built on it open a Bambu Studio project as their own, without questions about its version, and a PrusaSlicer project as a project of theirs, each bed a plate. A plain 3MF in several colours gets an extruder per colour in the slicers that read no 3MF colours. A file that already opens as well as it can opens as it is. The copy is made on your Thingport instance, offline too, and the stored file never changes. Right-click a slicer under Configuration → Slicer to switch Open adapted off for it. The old copy's faults are gone with it: PrusaSlicer no longer swaps your printer for a 200 × 200 one named after the file or drops single-part objects, the slicers built on OrcaSlicer keep a project's parts and plates, and a 567 MB project that ran out of memory adapts in about a minute. Thanks to SeoliteQ (#67), maxbrueckl (#216) and truri83 (#261, #262).

images.caption: Open adapted in OrcaSlicer, beside the regular Open, for the printer you print on

items.title: Made for the printer you print on
items.description: A project names the printer it was made for, often not yours: a MakerWorld model made on an A1 mini opens on an A1 mini. Add your printers under Configuration → Printer, from the 971 printers of 190 brands that ten slicers know, with their pictures, and the copy for Bambu Studio, OrcaSlicer, Snapmaker Orca, Elegoo Slicer, Anycubic Slicer Next, Flash Studio or QIDI Studio names your slicer's own presets for your printer: the printer as your slicer has it, the process at the height and quality the designer started from, and each filament as the same product for your printer or a generic one of its type, with the designer's changes on top. Each plate's objects and its wipe tower move onto your bed. Pick the printer for each slicer from its right-click menu under Configuration → Slicer, or let Thingport ask Which printer is this for? the first time and remember the answer. The model page's button says which printer a copy is for, and its menu downloads the copy as well. Printers your library points at are suggested: the ones your prints were sliced for and your projects are made for, and Not mine turns one down. Signed in to a printer maker's site, you're asked whether to find your printers there: the ones bound to your Bambu Lab account through MakerWorld, those in your Creality Cloud, Snapmaker and Flashforge (VoxelShare) accounts, and the printer your MakerOnline profile names; only each printer's model and nozzle are kept. Creality Print asks for the printer itself, and PrusaSlicer, eufyMake Studio and Cura put a copy on the printer selected in them, so their copies don't change with yours.

images.caption: Configuration → Printer: the printers your library suggests, and Find them in your accounts
Which printer is this for? Asked the first time, and remembered for that slicer

items.title: Download adapted in Thingport Grab, on nine sites
items.description: Thingport Grab's Download adapted makes the same copies in your browser, with or without a Thingport instance, and not on MakerWorld alone: on Printables, Creality Cloud, Snapmaker Space, NexPrint, MakerOnline, eufyMake, QIDI Maker and VoxelShare too. Adapt 3MFs, in its popup, has settings of its own: your slicers, your printers from the list Grab carries, where the button goes and the sites it works on. Connected, Grab makes the copies for your Thingport instance's slicers and printers instead, going by what the instance said last while it can't be reached, and a slicer whose Open adapted is off gets none. The button sits beside the site's own, named after the copy a click makes, with the others in its menu. On Printables' Files tab and NexPrint's Files list each 3MF gets one of its own, and where the site's button doesn't show, or you'd rather, the copies are in Grab's bubble. A copy is made of the print profile or the 3MF picked on the page, and follows it. The popup now shows Grab's sites as tiles, five to a row, and a line along a tile's edge marks the ones Download adapted works on.

images.caption: Download adapted beside MakerWorld's own button, a copy for each slicer and printer
Adapt 3MFs in Grab's popup: the slicers and printers its copies are made for

items.title: See what takes the disk, and free up space
items.description: Administration → Storage used to say only how much pictures and previews took. Its card now splits the disk by kind in one bar: model files, 3D previews, old 3D previews, photos, thumbnails and renders, description images, slicer copies and the rest. Free up space offers what can go, each with about what it frees: old 3D previews and renders that nothing shows any more, the 3D previews drawn before this release packed to about a fifth of their size, the slicer copies of adapted 3MFs, which are made again when they're needed, and each model's photos past the first 1, 3, 5 or 10, the cover always kept. That last one can't be undone, so it's never ticked for you and asks first. The clean-ups run in the background, one after another with their progress, and a notification says how much was freed. Photos kept per model sets how many photos imports and re-syncs keep from now on. A model's 3D previews and slicer copies now live in its Images folder with its pictures, so they move with it and go when it's deleted, and a new 3D preview is packed as it's drawn and takes the place of the plate's older ones.

images.caption: Administration → Storage: the disk by kind, and how many photos imports keep
Free up space: what can go, and about how much each frees

items.title: Import from QIDI Maker and VoxelShare: twenty-three sites
items.description: Two printer makers' model communities to import from, each with its slicer. QIDI Maker, QIDI Tech's: models, their QIDI Studio print profiles and anyone's public collections with no sign-in, and your own collections and likes, synced too, with the sign-in Thingport Grab hands over. VoxelShare, Flashforge's: models, their print profiles for Flashforge's printers and their files in the designer's folders, and anyone's public collections, with no sign-in, and your own collections and likes, synced too, without adding to your download history there. A model VoxelShare copied from another site says where it was first published. Both bring their categories, trending models and licences, and both are on for everyone after the update. Their slicers come too: QIDI Studio opens models through Thingport Bridge, as it asks each time whether to trust a link, and Flash Studio downloads them itself or through the Bridge. Both get adapted copies made for your printer, and Grab's Download adapted works on both sites. Thanks to krolbot for QIDI Studio and QIDI Maker (#326, #340).

images.caption: Administration → Providers, newest first: VoxelShare and QIDI Maker

items.title: Move to this instance from another one
items.description: Administration → Migrate brings another Thingport instance's people and libraries into this one. Online, the old instance's admin makes a token there, good for 24 hours, and this instance downloads its database and reads its files over the network. Or, from any release since 1.0.0, with nothing to change on the old instance, bring its database dump and storage folder: How do I make these? gives the commands, filled in for both servers. The copy is brought up to this release, checked, and merged keeping its ids, so a second run brings nothing twice. People come with their passwords, profiles, avatars, dashboards and achievements, and someone who already has an account here, under the same email, is merged into it. Models come with their files, categories, pictures and print profiles, filed in this instance's folder layout, with collections, synced collections, provider sign-ins, Studio designs, widgets and tools, and instance settings and secrets only if you pick them. Sessions, API tokens, Grab connections, the audit log, import history and chats stay behind. Migrate also brings in a Manyfold library, 0.149 or later, read with an API key made there: each model with its files in their folders, pictures, tags, licence, creator, notes and source, and its collections, each owner's models going to the person you pick.

images.caption: Administration → Migrate: from another Thingport instance or Manyfold, and a token for moving away

items.title: Achievements: badges for what you do in Thingport
items.description: Badges at the foot of My models, your best three on a shelf and the rest in a strip under them, for downloading and importing models, importing from each site, saving models made with each tool or in Studio, keeping collections in sync, from three sites too, using Thingport on most days, and a few secrets to find. Tiers go bronze, silver, gold, platinum, diamond and holographic, and only ever go up. A new badge comes as a toast and a notification, and the top two tiers get a moment of their own. Others see your badges on Explore and on connected instances: the badge and what it's for, not the counts behind it. Achievements are off until an admin turns them on under Administration → Social → Achievements, which works with social features off, and turning them on gives everyone what they'd already earned, in one notification.

images.caption: Achievements on My models: the best three on a shelf, the rest under them

items.title: 简体中文, and the China sites of Snapmaker Space and VoxelShare
items.description: Thingport and Thingport Grab now speak Simplified Chinese, every string of both, picked up by itself in a browser set to any Chinese, and listed as 简体中文 under Configuration → Appearance → Language. Two China sites import too, each with its own accounts: space.snapmaker.cn, Snapmaker Space's, and www.voxelshare.cn, VoxelShare's. Their models, collections and likes import and sync as the main sites' do, their links go back there, and each is signed in to on its own, from its main site's tile under Configuration → Providers. Grab sends their sign-ins from their own pages and keeps Snapmaker's fresh, and its Download adapted works on Snapmaker Space's China site as well. If you allowed Grab on Snapmaker Space before, the China site's connect steps say how to allow it there too.

images.caption: Eight languages now, Simplified Chinese the newest

items.title: One collection, several sources
items.description: A Thingport collection can now follow any number of lists, on one site or several: a MakerWorld collection of printer parts and a Printables one of upgrades in one collection, say. Each source has its own settings, status and Sync now in a section of the sync dialog, with Add source, and from two sources on an Overview with Sync all now. The badge on the collection shows up to three sources' logos, and past three a ring in their colours with the count. Merging collections keeps every source and the imports they queued. Thanks to SeoliteQ (#70).

items.title: Files keep the folders they came in
items.description: Where a designer sorted a model's files into folders, they stay there: Printables' and GrabCAD's folders, PIXUP's file groups, MyMiniFactory's archives, Makerables' uploads and any ZIP's own folders, less a folder every file is in. The model page lists the files under a heading per folder, the download picker zips one folder, the model's ZIP keeps them, and on disk they're real folders. Files in different folders may share a name.

items.title: Thingport Grab in your language
items.description: Grab now speaks every language Thingport does: English, Spanish, French, Lithuanian, Russian, Ukrainian, Belarusian and Simplified Chinese, in its popup and on the pages it adds to. It follows the browser's language, or the one picked at the top of its Appearance tab. Thanks to krolbot (#328).

images.caption: Grab's language, at the top of its Appearance tab

items.title: Grab solves MakerWorld's and MakerOnline's puzzles with you
items.description: When MakerWorld or MakerOnline wants a puzzle solved before it hands over a file, Grab now shows the site's own puzzle and carries on once it's solved, where it used to stop with instructions. A guided MakerWorld collection run opens it on the page it paused on and goes on from the same model, and waits with Show puzzle if it's closed unsolved; an import from a model page's panel opens it too. A MakerWorld link imported in Thingport that meets its CAPTCHA now waits for Grab, with the links after it, for anyone with Grab paired: the import queue says how many imports wait for MakerWorld's puzzle, Solve on MakerWorld takes you there, and Grab opens the puzzle and brings them in.

items.title: eufyMake's print files, as print profiles
items.description: eufyMake's models now often come with print files, eufyMake Studio projects their designer made, and Thingport imports them as print profiles, as it does from MakerWorld or NexPrint: the first one, or the one a link names, or all of them, shown on the model page with what the site says of each. A model without print files brings its model files as before. Nothing needs a sign-in, and Grab's panel lists them.

items.title: Invite people with a link when there's no email set up
items.description: With registration closed and no email set up, Administration → Auth had no way to add anyone. Invite users now makes the invitation either way. Without email, it gives you the link to send yourself, for one address, single use and good for 7 days, with a button to copy it; with email, invitations go by email as before. Thanks to CandidB (#310).

items.title: Thingport Bridge says when a newer one is out
items.description: The first time an older Thingport Bridge opens a file, its owner gets a notification that a newer one is out, once for each version, opening Downloads. Updating is installing the new one over the old, settings kept, and on macOS that now works: the old Bridge used to go on opening every link until you logged out, and the new one was stopped. Now the new Bridge takes the old one's place, and the next link opens it. Updating? in the Download dialog says how, and how to check which version you have. The new Bridge also finds QIDI Studio and Flash Studio.

items.title: After a tool saves a model, its toast has an Open button that goes straight to the model, and the tools say so in your language
A model's page puts its category and size on one row, and says when the model was imported under its info box
Free MyMiniFactory models whose files are archives import without a MyMiniFactory sign-in
Russian, Ukrainian and Belarusian are complete, licences included, thanks to krolbot (#327)
Grab's popup footer has the ways to support Thingport, Buy Me a Coffee and GitHub Sponsors
Turned parts face the right way in the 3D preview, card renders and colour pictures; the ones drawn before are drawn again as they're next viewed
Importing several of a MakerWorld model's print profiles with Grab no longer looks stopped after the second, nor spends downloads on profiles the model already has, thanks to slewantoski (#333)
Pairing Grab carries on through the browser's permission prompt, thanks to krolbot (#330)
A Bambu Studio project whose plate holds a wrapper object no longer shows an empty plate when the browser draws its preview
A deleted or private Snapmaker Space model says it's gone, instead of failing with code 712001
NexPrint models whose ids start with C import, with their print profiles, and Grab knows their pages
Administration → Social has its icon again where an ad blocker's social filter hid it
A plain-text description keeps its <https://…> links and <name@example.com> addresses
A model's info box taller than the window, or under a taller top bar, no longer sticks out of reach
